name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: A blood test used to evaluate your overall health.

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
description: A test to assess the health of your liver.
instruction: Fast for 10-12 hours before the test.

name: Stool Culture
description: A test to detect the presence of bacteria or parasites in the stool.
instruction: Collect stool sample in a sterile container.

name: Thyroid Function Test (TFT)
description: A test to measure thyroid gland performance.
instruction: Avoid thyroid medication 24 hours before the test.

name: Urinalysis
description: A routine test to analyze urine content.
instruction: Collect the first morning urine sample.

name: Sputum Culture
description: A test to detect bacterial or fungal infections in the lungs.
instruction: Collect sputum first thing in the morning after rinsing your mouth.

name: Vitamin D Test
description: A test to measure the level of Vitamin D in the blood.

name: Influenza PCR
description: A test to detect the presence of influenza virus RNA.
instruction: Avoid eating or drinking 30 minutes before collecting the sample.

name: COVID-19 Antigen Test
description: A test to detect active COVID-19 infection.
instruction: Avoid eating or drinking 30 minutes before the test.

name: Bocavirus PCR
description: A test to detect the presence of bocavirus DNA.
